content:
maya: Heads up — main CI is failing on the deploy job for the canary rollout. Quick log: 

maya: ```
Run deploy-to-gke job
Error: 403 Permission denied: iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken
Caused by: service account key invalid or credentials missing
```

oliver: ugh, saw a couple flakes earlier but not this. Is this the job that uses GCP_SA_KEY secret?

maya: yes, deploy uses GCP_SA_KEY (json key) to impersonate the infra SA. Looks like the actions runner can't mint tokens.

eng-ci-bot: @maya — I queued a rerun for job 12891 as requested. If the secret is expired rerun will fail.

sana: quick checks: (1) repo settings -> Secrets -> GCP_SA_KEY present? (2) check IAM binding for service account -> has roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator?

jamal: I can check IAM. Give me 2m. Also check that GH Actions has id-token permission in workflow. Missing id-token causes OIDC flow to fail.

maya: workflow has id-token: write already. This is key-based flow not OIDC, we still use the JSON key. Could the key have been revoked by rotational job?

jamal: looking now... yep, the key fingerprint in the repo secret doesn't match any active keys on infra-sa@project. I think the service account key was rotated and the secret not updated.

oliver: cool -- if that's true, easiest path is to re-create a key, update repo secret, and rerun. Who's got perms to create keys? I can but will need to check process.

maya: @oliver go ahead if you have permissions. Otherwise tag me and I'll coordinate with infra. We need to re-upload to GitHub and not post the JSON here.

jamal: creating new key now and will hand off securely.

eng-ci-bot: Note: rotating service account keys will trigger audit log events. Make sure to include ticket id when updating secrets.

oliver: uploaded new key to repo, secret name unchanged. I also toggled repository actions secret: updated GCP_SA_KEY.

maya: re-running job now.

eng-ci-bot: Rerun queued: job 12892.

deploy-bot: job 12892 finished — status: failure — logs show same 403.

jamal: hmm, did the key get the correct roles? I accidentally created a key for a different SA. Re-checking...

oliver: oh damn, I used infra-deploy-sa vs infra-ci-sa. Replaced with proper key now.

maya: rerun again when ready.

eng-ci-bot: Rerun queued: job 12893.

deploy-bot: job 12893 finished — status: success :tada:

maya: nice, thanks team. Follow-up: I'll add a short doc on key rotation + update the rotation script to also push to GitHub Actions secrets via the ops account. Ticket: INFRA-442.

sana: great. Also recommend moving to OIDC/workload identity to avoid long-lived keys. +1 to INFRA-442 for migration work.

oliver: noted. closing this thread, moving follow-up to INFRA-442 and a PR for the doc. :thumbsup:
